plan_wait: The planner has prepared a plan. Review and approve it — agents will then run everything automatically up to the final review.
plan_none: The plan appears here after the planning stage.
replan_ph: Comment for the planner, e.g. “don’t touch the public API, add a feature flag”
reject_body: The branch {{branch}} and all its commits will be deleted. The task returns to the backlog.
delete_body: The task and its log will be removed. Git branches are not touched.
waiting_review_block: Waits until the task in review is accepted or rejected
no_reports: Reports appear as agents finish their stages.
no_release: The version is proposed after all checks pass.
no_changes: No changes on the task branch yet.
home_sub: An IDE for managing AI agents. Open a project — Vexa respects its CLAUDE.md, agents and .claude settings.
clone_hint: After you press Clone, choose the folder to clone into.
no_projects: No projects yet. Open a folder with your code to get started.
env_logged_out: Run “claude” in a terminal and sign in
git_not_repo: This folder is not a git repository yet.
git_clean: Nothing to commit — working tree clean.
ag_sub: Built-in agents for the full cycle. Change the prompt, model and allowed tools.
claude_md_none: No CLAUDE.md in this project yet. Create one so every agent knows the commands and conventions.
set_iter_d: How many times a task goes back to the developer after failed tests/review/security
set_model_d: Used by agents that don’t set their own model. Empty = Claude Code default
set_auto_d: When the subscription limit is hit, the queue pauses and resumes after the reset
set_wait_d: Don’t start implementing the next task in a project while another one waits for your review
nt_ph: e.g. Add a dark theme to settings
nt_dph: What needs doing, acceptance criteria, constraints…
toast_approved: Plan approved — the task is in the queue
toast_rejected: Branch deleted, task returned to backlog
err_dirty: Uncommitted changes in the project. Commit or stash them on the Git screen, then retry.
ad_planner: Explores the code and writes a plan
nt_discuss_hint: The planner will ask clarifying questions and offer implementation options before writing the plan.
nt_branch_hint: Leave empty to name it automatically.
nt_branch_locked: The branch already exists and can no longer be renamed.
questions_hint: Pick an option or write your own answer. Leave a question empty to let the planner decide.
delete_branch_body: The branch is removed locally. Commits that exist only on it will be lost if it is not merged.
delete_branch_force: The branch is not merged. Delete it anyway?
tour_again_d: A step-by-step walk through the interface
tw_welcome_d: Vexa runs your Claude Code as a team of agents: you create tasks, approve the plan and accept the result. Everything else happens automatically. Let’s take a quick look around.
tw_open_d: Pick any folder with code. Vexa respects the project’s CLAUDE.md, .claude settings, hooks and agents. You can also clone a repository.
tw_env_d: Claude Code must be installed and signed in (your Pro/Max subscription is used — no API keys). Git is needed for branches.
tw_settings_d: Language, theme, fix-iteration limit, default model and what happens when the subscription limit is hit. You can restart this tour from here.
tb_new_d: Describe what needs doing. Tick “Discuss before planning” if you want the planner to ask questions first, and set a branch name if you like.
tb_board_d: Tasks move left to right: backlog → queue → planning → plan approval → in progress → ready for review → done. Drag cards between backlog and queue.
tb_queue_d: Tasks run strictly one at a time, each on its own branch, so they can’t break each other. Pause the queue here at any time.
tb_flow_d: You approve the plan (or answer the planner’s questions), then review the diff, reports and version at the end and press “Accept & merge”. Clicking a card opens its live log.
tb_git_d: Commit, branches, history, pull and push — all with buttons.
tb_agents_d: Six built-in agents: planner, developer, tester, reviewer, security auditor and release manager. Change their prompts, models and tools here.
tb_project_d: CLAUDE.md, versions and CHANGELOG. Generate a CLAUDE.md with one button.
tb_status_d: The running task and your subscription usage for the 5-hour and weekly windows. When the limit runs out, the queue waits and continues by itself.
